Tests that WebSocket frame error is emitted.
WebSocketCreated
  url: ws://127.0.0.1:8000/does_not_exist
  has requestId: true
  has initiator: true
WebSocketWillSendHandshakeRequest
  has wallTime: true
  has request headers: true
WebSocketFrameError
  has timestamp: true
  errorMessage: Error during WebSocket handshake: Unexpected response code: 404
WebSocketClosed
  has timestamp: true
